notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Patch 1.1 is a balance of bug fixes and quality of life features. Thanks to everyone who gave feedback in our Steam community and on Reddit!

• Fixed a bug where the Apply Roll button would stay disabled in rare scenarios during a fight.
• Fixed a bug where using Bare Hands in a fight would still show "Handgun" below the dice selection.
• Added tooltips for the Regroup and Hide buttons.
• Health and Time will remain visible during tests and choices where knowing those values is critical.
• Small visual update to inventory card activation buttons.
• Updated wording in the tutorial during the first fight to better explain fight mechanics and strategy.
• Updated the mouse cursor.
• Added a link to the official tabletop game rules in the bottom right corner of the game screen.
• Added a link to our Discord in the bottom right corner of the menu screen.
